title: service-queue: a job whose worker dies mid-handler stays `running` forever — `leaseMs` promises a reclaim nothing performs
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named locus. Found out of scope by the #29919 card thread (os-dev-report 6648028230, class b) and re-read by the seat at `origin/main` `dfafae81`. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes it.

## Defect

`packages/services/service-queue/src/db-queue-adapter.ts`:

- `DbQueueAdapterOptions.leaseMs` (:158) is documented as "Lease duration before another worker may reclaim (ms, default 30000)".
- `claimBatch` selects candidates with `status: 'pending'` only (:528) and sets a claimed row to `status: 'running'` with `locked_until = now + leaseMs` (:577–579). The lease check at :568 reads `locked_until` on a `pending` row, where every write back to `pending` has already cleared it.
- Every write that returns a row to `pending` (:625, :641, :655, :675) runs inside the live worker after the handler settles. No reader in `service-queue` returns a `running` row whose `locked_until` has passed.

So a worker that dies mid-handler (process crash, OOM, a redeploy) leaves its row `running` for good: it is never retried and never dead-lettered, and the lease the option documents is never enforced. Not reproduced end-to-end; the reading is the code path above.

## Business reason

Who is hurt: any deployment that runs scheduled or background jobs through `QueueServicePlugin`'s database adapter (the default durable queue). A job lost to a crash or a deploy silently never runs, with nothing in the queue telling an operator. If not done: the documented `leaseMs` stays a promise the runtime does not keep (declared, not enforced).

## Acceptance

1. A `running` row whose `locked_until` has passed is claimable again (or moved to the retry path with its attempt counted), within one idle tick of the lease running out.
2. A live worker that is still inside its lease is never double-claimed.
3. Pins: a crashed-worker fixture (row left `running` with an expired lease) is reclaimed; a row inside its lease is not. The `nextDueAt` read #29919 adds (PR #30225) also counts the earliest lease expiry, so a sole-writer loop wakes for it.

## Reader who acts

`domain:server` lane, after triage. Serial after PR #30225 (#29919), which changes the same file's idle loop.

## Dedup

Searched issues, open and closed: "DbQueueAdapter running lease reclaim" (1 hit, #29919 itself), "sys_job_queue stuck running" (3 hits: #29919, and seat posts #6367, #6015), "leaseMs never enforced" (1 hit, #29919). No card carries it.

## Re-check

`git grep -n -A3 "status: 'pending'" origin/main -- packages/services/service-queue/src/db-queue-adapter.ts` (the claim predicate) and `git grep -n "Lease duration before another worker may reclaim" origin/main -- packages/services/service-queue/src/db-queue-adapter.ts`.
